bootstrap.empty_scored_set: Null point scores and intervals; zero valid draws; preserve all abstention denominators.
bootstrap.interpretation: Fixed-prediction descriptive intervals, not population significance or retraining estimates.
bootstrap.unit: Paired resampling of shared scored components with replacement, conditional on fixed out-of-fold predictions; same draws for all methods. Compute component-equal and track-weighted Brier/log-loss differences.

census_before_fit.action: Seal identities/folds first, then publish/seal label-availability and per-class support census before any fit. If global support fails, report no fit; do not acquire alternatives, alter task, drop classes or reseed.

cohort: All 11565 metadata nominations remain in the denominator. Build native artist+album connected components across the complete metadata cohort before reading any human target cells; minimum track ID is component ID. Reject duplicate track/path aliases and mismatched joined native identity fields. Preserve unmatched/missing/incomplete/invalid human targets and separately count taxonomy nominations, exactly-three-recognized-vote eligible tracks, and all disagreements. Never filter to consensus.
features: Only uploader genre--- and instrument--- tags. No uploader mood/theme, human taxonomy, native IDs, names, titles, paths or duration are model features. Vocabulary is training-only, sorted, occurring but not universal across eligible training rows.
fit_gate: Each outer fold uses only eligible training tracks outside that fold. Each of all nine classes must have at least one positive vote in at least five distinct training components. Otherwise all matched methods abstain for that fold. Never gate on heldout class counts or outcomes; report zero heldout support and undefined classwise metric without dropping a class.
interpretation: Prospectively frozen new human-genre target on the same historical metadata identities as the completed happiness/calibration studies. Uploader genres are predictors, not human truth. Annotation blinding and annotator independence are not established. No audio, musical similarity, recommendation usefulness, population confirmation or EveryNoise parity claim; no acquisition retry or paid service.

auxiliary: descriptive per-class votes/track/component support and classwise scores; undefined if no heldout support
metrics.clip_policy: Clip probabilities only inside log loss to [1e-15,1], without renormalization; leave Brier probabilities exact. Report number of positive-target class cells clipped and affected tracks per method.
metrics.denominators: All metadata, taxonomy-nominated, eligible, predicted, scored and fold-abstained track/component denominators; proper scores describe only the shared scored subset if any fold abstains.
metrics.primary: Individual-vote multiclass Brier=sum_c(p_c^2)-2*sum_c(p_c*y_c)+1; average within eligible scored component then equally across components. No class reweighting.

nb: theta_cj=(1+sum_i w_i*y_ic*x_ij)/(2+sum_i w_i*y_ic). log score_c=log(pi_c)+sum_j[x_j*log(theta_cj)+(1-x_j)*log(1-theta_cj)]. Normalize all nine scores with logsumexp. Fixed alpha one, no tuning/calibration. Empty vocabulary equals prior.
prediction: For a supported training fold, predict all metadata queries from permitted features only; retain human target availability separately and score only eligible targets. Missing/invalid heldout votes never determine predictions or fold fit. Global census support is a pre-fit experiment-feasibility gate only.
prior: pi_c=(1+sum_i w_i*y_ic)/(9+sum_i w_i), fixed alpha one in each class.

rights.attribution: Music Technology Group; Bogdanov, Won, Tovstogan, Porter and Serra (2019), The MTG-Jamendo Dataset for Automatic Music Tagging; Music Classification Annotations documentation
rights.commit_policy: Code, protocol and restrained aggregate research results only; raw data, per-track predictions and fitted artifacts remain local under source terms; no serving or deployment

uploader_baseline: Uniform probability over distinct mapped classes whose literal genre--- token is present; if none, use the same training human prior. No smoothing, no instrument-only baseline, no taxonomy search.
weights: Every eligible training component has unit total weight; each eligible row weight is 1/(eligible training rows in its component). Fractional target y_c = recognized class-c votes / 3.
